passages.note: Restricts body armor for persons already prohibited from firearms; not a firearm-regulation measure the ladder orders.

rows.reasoning: AB 92 (Connolly), chaptered September 26, 2023, makes it a crime for persons already prohibited from possessing a firearm to purchase, own, or possess body armor. It regulates body armor, not firearms, and does not speak to civilian firearm ownership, assault-style weapons, background checks, or carry rules, which is what this ladder's rungs differ on. No surviving passage establishes a chair.
needs_source: A record (bill authored, sponsored, or voted on by Connolly) or statement addressing civilian firearm ownership, assault-style weapon restrictions, background checks, or carry/permit rules
